credentials.title: ButterflyMX API credentials
credentials.description: This copy of the integration does not ship a client ID, so you need one of your own from ButterflyMX's developer programme. Leave the redirect URI at its default unless ButterflyMX registered a custom one for your application.

authorize.title: Link your ButterflyMX account
authorize.description:
1. Open this link and sign in with your ButterflyMX account:

{authorize_url}

2. Approve access.
3. ButterflyMX will show you an authorization code (or send you to {redirect_uri} with a `code` parameter).
4. Paste the code - or the whole URL you landed on - below.

The code is single use and expires quickly, so paste it promptly.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect ButterflyMX
reauth_confirm.description: The stored ButterflyMX authorization for client `{account}` is no longer valid. Continue to link the account again.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach ButterflyMX. Check your network and the endpoint URLs.
error.invalid_auth: ButterflyMX rejected these credentials or this authorization code.
error.invalid_auth_code: That does not look like an authorization code.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This ButterflyMX account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: Those credentials are for a different ButterflyMX account.

init.title: ButterflyMX options
init.description:
Polling is the default and works everywhere.

Push needs Home Assistant to be reachable from the internet. Turning it on registers this URL with ButterflyMX:

{webhook_url}

Check that address is reachable before enabling it. Polling does not stop when push is on, it only slows down: a call delivered while Home Assistant is restarting is gone for good, so the slow poll stays on to catch anything push misses. If doorbells stop arriving, turn push off and confirm polling still works - see the README for how to check.

data.enable_webhook: Also let ButterflyMX push calls (needs an externally reachable Home Assistant)

create_delivery_pass.name: Create delivery pass
create_delivery_pass.description: Creates a single-use code for a delivery, the same thing the ButterflyMX app calls a delivery code. It opens every door, starts now and lasts 30 days or until it is used, whichever comes first. Returns the PIN and QR link, which are not stored anywhere in Home Assistant.

name.name: Name
name.description: What this pass is for. It is what the access log shows when the code is used, so make it something you will recognise later.

create_visitor_pass.name: Create visitor pass
create_visitor_pass.description: Creates a reusable code valid over a window, the same thing the ButterflyMX app calls a visitor code. Returns the PIN and QR link, which are not stored anywhere in Home Assistant.

name.name: Name
name.description: Who the pass is for. It is what the access log shows when the code is used.

starts_at.name: Valid from
starts_at.description: When the code starts working. Defaults to now.

ends_at.name: Valid until
ends_at.description: When the code stops working. Defaults to four hours after it starts.

doors.name: Doors
doors.description: Which doors the code opens. Leave empty for all of them.

list_passes.name: List passes
list_passes.description: Returns every pass on this unit, PINs and QR links included. This is how to read a code back off a pass you created earlier: the codes are deliberately kept out of the sensor, so they have to be asked for.

revoke_pass.name: Revoke pass
revoke_pass.description: Deletes a pass and every code it issued. This cannot be undone.

pass_id.name: Pass ID
pass_id.description: The ID of the pass to delete, as shown in the Passes sensor's attributes or returned when it was created.

not_a_passes_sensor.message: {entity} is not a ButterflyMX passes sensor. Target the unit's Passes sensor instead.

unknown_pass.message: {entity} has no pass with ID {pass_id}. It may have been revoked already, or it may belong to another unit.

pass_window_backwards.message: A visitor pass cannot end before it starts (from {starts_at} until {ends_at}).
